designDecisions.decision: Used the value context only to support a bespoke integrated estate composition, not to infer price, cost, or mandatory area.
designDecisions.limitation: No valuation, cost estimate, or luxury certification is represented.

designDecisions.decision: Constructed a four-sided courtyard composition with solid walls, deep roof shade, and warm limestone/ivory expression.
designDecisions.limitation: Arches and tiled roof detail are not dedicated supported geometry.

designDecisions.decision: Established a dominant living hall, subordinate programmed wings, protected court, and separate guest garden destination.
designDecisions.limitation: Detailed loose interior furniture and service equipment are not modeled.

designDecisions.decision: Built a usable south approach, cut door opening, fitted entrance, canopy, and supporting posts.
Coordinated ivory enclosure, limestone bases/posts, bronze doors, timber screens, and articulated roof edges.
designDecisions.limitation: Material selections do not certify craftsmanship or durability.

designDecisions.decision: Reserved a broad 10 x 8 m central outdoor court with usable depth rather than a residual shaft.
designDecisions.limitation: No automated courtyard daylight or circulation analysis is available.

designDecisions.decision: Made the south salon roof higher and broader than the surrounding residential wings.
Used four separately sized hip roofs to retain an open sky court and legible subordinate wings.
designDecisions.limitation: Waterproofing, drainage, and roof loading are not represented.

designDecisions.decision: Used actual wall openings and inset entrance/glazed bays rather than surface-applied window trim.
designDecisions.limitation: The model provides geometric depth, not a boolean arch or custom stone surround.

designDecisions.decision: Created shaded court edges, a rear terrace, outdoor seating, and an open garden lounge pavilion.
designDecisions.limitation: No appliances, plumbing, smoke extraction, or outdoor-kitchen equipment is modeled.

designDecisions.decision: Applied broad eaves and timber screens as climate-responsive shade while retaining sheltered outdoor living.
designDecisions.limitation: Climate, hurricane, corrosion, and thermal performance are not simulated.

designDecisions.decision: Placed screening on the west wing under an assumed afternoon exposure condition.
designDecisions.limitation: West orientation is assumed, not surveyed.

limitations: Surface areas are per physical element; overlapping surfaces are not additional usable area. Enclosed area, requested-space completeness, pool construction and circulation require architectural review. A renderable model is not a completed building.
